decision: One original complete unitless open overshirt source and first view; independent critic and root must admit unchanged literal source before the sole CPU export/check and first browser render.
usable_improvement: Editable original artist-source JSON and quad OBJ, complete relaxed torso/back, attached pointed folded collar, integrated front facing, hem and wrist cuffs, full hanging sleeves; isolated fixed front/profile/rear viewer.
research_question: Does the first complete authored garment and untouched triptych make the open collar, separate front edges, full sleeves and rear volume legible enough for subsequent artist refinement?
evidence_can_change: A keep source/blockout as a usable original wardrobe starting point; B retain rejected evidence without asset promotion.
stop: First source refusal, CPU topology/export failure, retrieval/render failure or visual rejection closes this experiment. No geometry/material/camera rescue, second export or second capture. Source-gate deadline11:16/work deadline11:40 UTC. Gate diagnostics and checkpoint work may finish after stop but cannot admit operations then.
authoring: Cora-owned literal unitless numeric coordinates and construction; X lateral/Y upright/+Z front. Front L/R, back, side and shoulder bridges own shared named indices. Eight-point sleeve roots are actual sewn body edges. Stand/leaf join actual seven-point neck chain. Hidden rear depth and all sleeve/collar dimensions are new artist choices, not recovered image dimensions. Face winding normalisation belongs to first original constructor, before export.
topology_contract: Single connected orientable manifold quad surface with an actual continuous collar/front/hem free boundary and two cuff boundaries, genus0/Euler -1. Derive graph counts and named boundary roles; do not inherit sweater four-loop topology. No fuzzy coordinate welding, old-net resampling, body offset or fit/rig transfer.
source_gate: Read complete build.py, check.py, viewer.mjs, index.html, original brief/reference limits and current plan. Critic provides literal source witnesses, two alternatives and whether the sole export/first view is worth doing. Root verifies all handoff bindings and independently inspects source. Source-only no execution/network/GPU by critic.
cpu: One build.py invocation emits new export/mesh.json and export/overshirt.obj only if owned export folder absent. One independent check.py invocation verifies finite coordinates, unique nonzero-area quad faces, edge incidence/oriented twins, one face component, vertex-link paths/cycles, exact named boundary graph, Euler and OBJ roundtrip. No test suite mirrors implementation or cloth/self-intersection/fit proof.
native: Root only, one new owned hidden iab tab, one renderer/no animation, one fixed three-view render and original viewport screenshot saved without edits. Existing user tabs/review server preserved. Viewer source fixes material/light/cameras before first load. Only readonly DOM/source observations; no retakes. Close owned tab after collecting original/record, do not claim observed WebGL disposal from tab closure alone.
camera_and_material: Olive rough clay front surface and darker inner surface; no fabric thickness/cloth/material finish claim. One orthographic viewport per front/profile/rear with target fixed from first mesh bounds and half extent formula fixed in viewer source. Labels and exact export links. 1280x900 viewport.
references: Already observed unedited original concept-v1.png and retained official J.Crew primary-page.jpg. Retained folded collar/placket cannot add hidden geometry through repeated retrieval; no new online query/capture in this contract. References are Oct4 observations, not current availability claims.
scope: No body/tee/rig/expression/groom runtime, scene-default or accepted asset changes, global tooling install or Blender recovery. Blockout/source scope only; wearable motion/clearance, fabric finish, character starter and full AAA goals remain open. Preserve frozen/accepted/default/original/unrelated work; no push/publish/capacity/model/subscription/credit/other-project action. Newer Robert check-in/pause supersedes this plan.
jobs: No background native/GPU worker. Sole export/check foreground under30 seconds. Root records exact source hashes/commands/results and native tab/capture IDs; critic never captures. Stop/failure records owned process state and leaves review5173 intact.
